crossRefs.note: The morsel which you have eaten you shall vomit up, and lose your good words.

translations.web: The morsel which you have eaten you shall vomit up, and lose your good words.
translations.bsb: You will vomit up what little you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.
translations.kjv: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.
translations.asv: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, And lose thy sweet words.
